notes: MG1655 WT and atoC/btsR/cusR/rcsB deletions in M9, LB or 0.1x LB with effectors. Treatments: CuSO4 -> metal_excess; 5% ethanol -> envelope_solvent_biocide; LiCl and acetoacetate/LiCl -> other_chemical (LiCl is the salt; acetoacetate itself would be a nutrient); pyruvate 100 uM -> nutrient supplement, treatment none (so WT 0.1x LB + pyruvate is a control). Exposure 'adapted' from 'grown in the presence of' (no time given; somewhat uncertain). M9 carbon source not stated. There is no untreated WT in M9 or full LB; WT 0.1x LB (+/- pyruvate) are the only controls. Culture 'batch' but shaking not stated: culture_mode and oxygen left out. WT re-read: reference -> wild_type, MG1655 wt, no construct. | 2026-11-20: a broth below full strength is neither rich nor minimal, so medium_class is left empty for it (base_medium kept). Applies to the 0.1x LB samples.
